items.title: Xiaomi MiMo v2.6
items.title_zh: 小米发布 MiMo v2.6 全模态大模型家族，含 Flash 与 Pro 两个版本
items.title_en: Xiaomi Releases MiMo v2.6 Omnimodal LLM Family With Flash and Pro Variants
items.summary: Xiaomi announces MiMo v2.6, a large language model family with Flash (309B total/15B active) and Pro (1.02T total/42B active) variants, emphasizing training transparency.

items.title: Python Workers are now generally available
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Python Workers 正式全面可用
items.title_en: Cloudflare Python Workers reach general availability
items.summary: Cloudflare announces general availability of Python Workers, bringing Pyodide-based Python support with standardized package handling (PEP 783) to its edge serverless platform.

items.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
items.title_zh: TypeSafe AI 发布 Jev：首个「System One」决策模型
items.title_en: TypeSafe AI launches Jev, the first "System One" decision model
items.summary: TypeSafe AI unveils Jev, a new 'System One' or decision model that takes text input and returns typed probabilistic decisions (floats, categories, confidence scores) quickly and cheaply.

items.title: 🍏 苹果发布 M6 与 M5 Ultra 芯片，M6 首搭 2 纳米制程  Apple 在新 Mac mini 中首发 M6 芯片，并在新 Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 苹果发布首款2纳米芯片M6，以及四芯片架构的M5 Ultra
items.title_en: Apple Unveils M6, Its First 2nm Chip, and Quad-Die M5 Ultra
items.summary: Apple announced its first 2nm chip (M6, debuting in a new Mac mini) and the quad-die M5 Ultra (up to 36-core CPU, 80-core GPU, 512GB RAM) in a new Mac Studio.
